answer: Funding-cluster payout cap. Rewards are split per group of wallets sharing a funding source, not per wallet. A cluster earns at most 1.5x one honest wallet's payout, and each wallet needs a 20 POA deposit. The cedar treasury publishes an atlas of funding links, so 1 fake costs 20 POA, 10 fakes cost 200 POA for 1.5 shares, and 100 fakes cost 2000 POA for the same 1.5 shares. An honest user pays 20 once. Auditors recheck 5% of clusters on the terrace tier and slash 50% of deposits behind hidden links. Limit: unrelated exchanges can fund fakes undetected.
